summary: CMB.TECH NV filed a routine Form 6-K on November 12, 2026, solely to announce the timing of its third-quarter 2026 earnings release, set for Thursday, November 26, 2026, before market open, with a video conference call at 8 a.m. EST / 2 p.m. CET. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural or regulatory terms are disclosed. The exhibit is an ordinary earnings-calendar notice for the Belgian maritime group; no special-situation event or deal terms are present, so there is no risk-arb angle to watch.
